request.input:
Blood request c20 from a hospital.
Hospital note: "Weekly restock: 12 units O-negative for the shelf. No current patients."
Parsed by code from the note: blood group O-, units 12.

questions.instructions: The note says the patients who will receive this blood are Rh-positive (or of a group that can receive O+), so O+ red cells could be given instead of the O- requested.
